title: colpodium planifolium
intro: Colpodium planifolium, commonly known as the Ceylon flat grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Colpodium planifolium are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
